newsitem.title: USA: Kao's Jergens relaunches skin products.
newsitem.headline: Kao's Jergens relaunches skin products.

text.p: Kao Corp's Andrew Jergens Co unit said Monday it launched the repositioned Jergens Skincare brand.
The company did not disclose the cost of the launch and could not be immediately reached to comment.
The company will also introduce a new life of skincare bars, Jergens Skincare Ultra Healing Cream, a new aplha hydroxy cream and Jergens Skincare Moisturizing Body Bars.

The moves create a single brand identity by "establishing a unified positioning, packaging look and advertising message for several Jergens products that had previously been marketed as separate brands," the company said in a statement.
